sections.text: This Master Services Agreement is entered into by Bluefin Robotics, Inc. (“Customer”) and Harbor Analytics LLC (“Provider”) as of November 1, 2026.

sections.heading: Services
sections.text: 1.	Services. Provider shall perform the services described in each Statement of Work.

sections.heading: Fees
sections.text: 2.	Fees. Customer shall pay the fees set out in each Statement of Work within thirty (30) days of invoice.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
sections.text: 3.	Confidentiality. Each party shall keep the other party's confidential information confidential and use it only to perform this Agreement.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.text: 4.	Limitation of Liability. Neither party's liability shall exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

sections.heading: Term
sections.text: 5.	Term. This Agreement continues for three (3) years unless terminated earlier.
